categories.name: أُمُورٌ تَخُصُّ مُلْكَ اللهِ فِي الزُّخْرُفِ
categories.nameEn: Aspects of Allah's Sovereignty in Surah Az-Zukhruf

items.verse: سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
items.verseEn: Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.

items.verse: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَـٰهٌۭ وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَـٰهٌۭ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
items.verseEn: And it is He [i.e., Allāh] who is [the only] deity in the heaven, and on the earth [the only] deity. And He is the Wise, the Knowing.

items.verse: وَتَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
items.verseEn: And blessed is He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them and with whom is knowledge of the Hour and to whom you will be returned.

items.verse: وَلَا يَمْلِكُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ ٱلشَّفَـٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَن شَهِدَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
items.verseEn: And those they invoke besides Him do not possess [power of] intercession; but only those who testify to the truth [can benefit], and they know.

categories.name: مَظَاهِرُ عَجْزِ الشُّرَكَاءِ فِي سُورَةِ الْأَعْرَافِ
categories.nameEn: Aspects of the False Gods' Inability in Surah Al-A'raf

items.verse: فَلَمَّآ ءَاتَىٰهُمَا صَـٰلِحًۭا جَعَلَا لَهُۥ شُرَكَآءَ فِيمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمَا ۚ فَتَعَـٰلَى ٱللَّهُ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
items.verseEn: But when He gives them a good [child], they ascribe partners to Him concerning that which He has given them. Exalted is Allāh above what they associate with Him.

items.verse: أَيُشْرِكُونَ مَا لَا يَخْلُقُ شَيْـًۭٔا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ
items.verseEn: Do they associate with Him those who create nothing and they are [themselves] created?

items.verse: وَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ لَهُمْ نَصْرًۭا وَلَآ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَنصُرُونَ
items.verseEn: And they [i.e., the false deities] are unable to [give] them help, nor can they help themselves.

items.verse: وَإِن تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰ لَا يَتَّبِعُوكُمْ ۚ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ أَدَعَوْتُمُوهُمْ أَمْ أَنتُمْ صَـٰمِتُونَ
items.verseEn: And if you [believers] invite them to guidance, they will not follow you. It is all the same for you whether you invite them or you are silent.

categories.name: حِوَارُ أَهْلِ النَّارِ مَعَ رَبِّهِمْ فِي سُورَةِ الْمُؤْمِنُون
categories.nameEn: Dialogue of the People of the Fire with their Lord in Surah Al-Mu'minun

items.verse: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَحَدَهُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ٱرْجِعُونِ
items.verseEn: [For such is the state of the disbelievers] until, when death comes to one of them, he says, "My Lord, send me back

items.verse: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتْ عَلَيْنَا شِقْوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوْمًۭا ضَآلِّينَ
items.verseEn: They will say, "Our Lord, our wretchedness overcame us, and we were a people astray.

items.verse: رَبَّنَآ أَخْرِجْنَا مِنْهَا فَإِنْ عُدْنَا فَإِنَّا ظَـٰلِمُونَ
items.verseEn: Our Lord, remove us from it, and if we were to return [to evil], we would indeed be wrongdoers."
He will say, "Remain despised therein and do not speak to Me.

categories.name: عَنَاصِرُ مُوَاجَهَةِ السَّحَرَةِ لِمُوسَى فِي سُورَةِ الشُّعَرَاءِ
categories.nameEn: Elements of the Magicians' Confrontation with Musa in Surah Ash-Shu'ara

items.verse: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا۟ لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
items.verseEn: And when the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, "Is there indeed for us a reward if we are the predominant?"

items.en: the ones who are brought near
items.verse: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًۭا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
items.verseEn: He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me]."

items.verse: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ
items.verseEn: Moses said to them, "Throw whatever you will throw."

items.verse: فَأَلْقَوْا۟ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ
items.verseEn: So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said, "By the might of Pharaoh, indeed it is we who are predominant."
